Description: XIAO ESP32-S3 (plain, 8MB flash / 8MB PSRAM) — WATCH build
Notes: Seats in W-U2's back socket, zero wiring (same stack pattern as Vision/Sense). Plain, NOT Sense: a display needs no camera/mic, and their absence is a privacy feature. Seeed list $7.49; 3-pack ~$5.97/pc; street (Amazon) $9-12

Description: Seeed Round Display for XIAO (1.28in 240x240 GC9A01, CST816S touch, PCF8563 RTC, microSD, LiPo charger, JST 1.25)
Notes: ARRIVED 2026-08 (bench validation unit in hand; Track W runnable). Seeed list $18.00 (street $24-26). 104030087 is the distributor-orderable SKU (DigiKey/Newark/TME; DigiKey hosts the datasheet under it) - 104040143 is a retail-channel alias for the same product that does not resolve at distributors. Firmware: canary-display-watch. Backlight on D6/GPIO43 is PWM-dimmable = bedside night floor. VERIFY pin map against board revision (docs/../boards/xiao-esp32s3-round)

Description: 3D-printed Watch Station puck (drum + snap bezel + 25deg cradle stand)
Notes: docs/hardware/enclosure/canary_watch_station.scad (v0.2-dev, not print-validated). Bore/bezel sized to the measured vendor CAD (Ø43.0 disc); bezel snaps into wall slots, no fasteners. Prints flat, no supports; wall-mounts via blind keyhole without the stand

Description: LiPo 302030 150mAh PROTECTED cell, JST 1.25 — battery-backed watch
Notes: SAFETY: protected (PCM) cells only. VERIFY JST 1.25 polarity against the display board before plugging — vendor pigtails vary. Fits the drum's opt_batt fence rails. Bulk 10+: $1-2.20/cell

Description: Passive piezo (UNPOPULATED in v0.1 firmware — future severity-tiered chime)
Notes: Reserved: display_ux_design.md sound spec (IEC 60601-1-8-informed tiers, falling all-clear tone). No firmware support yet

Description: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3 (800x480 IPS, GT911 5-pt touch, CH422G expander, 16MB flash / 8MB octal PSRAM) — DASH build
Notes: ORDERED 2026-07 as the 4.3B with-case SKU (bench unit; pin-identical + CAN/RS485 terminals, mic-free, bundled case replaces D-ENC1/D-SCR1). Plain ~$28-33; 4.3B $36.99. Firmware: canary-display-dash. Backlight is ON/OFF only (CH422G) — night mode is dark theme + backlight-off. VERIFY RGB timings/expander bits per board revision

Description: ALT: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3C "AI voice" variant, BOX SKU ships WITH plastic case (resellers: XYGStudy etc.)
Notes: Expected firmware-compatible (same RGB control pins/data GPIOs, GT911, CH422G; VERIFY ST7701 timings + extra LCD_RST expander bit at bench). Included case replaces D-ENC1/D-SCR1. CAVEAT: onboard dual-MIC array + ES8311 codec — inert (firmware never inits I2S) but physically present, so the no-mic-by-construction privacy posture does not hold on this SKU. Its speaker path is a v0.2 chime candidate

Description: 3D-printed Dash case (bezel frame + vented back + 25deg stand)
Notes: docs/hardware/enclosure/canary_dash_display.scad (v0.1-dev, not print-validated). Back carries 2x keyholes + 75mm horizontal M4 pair. MEASURE your panel before printing

Description: M2 x 8 self-tapping pan head (corner lobes, frame-to-back)
Notes: Generic M2 self-tap stock (the watch drum is fastener-free since v0.2)

Description: M4 x 10 machine screw (75mm-pair wall mount) or 2x #6 pan screws for keyholes
Notes: Only for wall mounting; desk stand needs no hardware

Description: USB-C cable, data-capable (not charge-only), 1m
Notes: Power + flashing. Both builds. 10-packs ~$1.30-1.60/cable

Description: USB-C PSU 5V/2A wall adapter (UL/ETL listed)
Notes: Both builds; always-on appliance — use a listed adapter. Bulk 100+: $0.60-1.50 landed (certified, Alibaba)

Description: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3B (isolated DI/DO + RS485 + CAN + I2C terminal, 6-36V in) — DEV PLAYGROUND host
Notes: The bench-mode board (docs/hardware/dev_playground_43b.md; firmware: canary-display-playground). Terminal block is the only wiring surface — no raw GPIO exposed. BOX SKU ships with case (bench unit on hand 2026-07)

Description: VEML7700 ambient light breakout (I2C 0x10) — playground light station
Notes: Preferred over BH1750: BH1750 default addr 0x23 collides with the CH422G — if using BH1750, strap ADDR high (0x5C). Wire to the I2C terminal; CHECK VOUT resistor option (5V default) vs breakout rating

Description: VL53L0X time-of-flight breakout (I2C 0x29) — playground ToF / gap station
Notes: Live mm + trip counter; doubles as the reflective beam-gap prototype pointed across an opening

Description: MPR121 12-pad capacitive touch breakout (I2C 0x5A) — playground cap-touch station
Notes: Shell-thickness sensitivity test with printed coupons (1/2/3/4mm) — procedure in dev_playground_43b.md. Foil or copper-tape electrode

Description: Momentary doorbell button (dry contact, any NO pushbutton) — DI0 station
Notes: Wired supply-side into DI0/DI COM (5-24V DC recommended). Any lighted doorbell button works if its lamp tolerates the loop voltage

Description: PIR or beam-break sensor with relay / open-collector output, 5-24V — DI1 intrusion station
Notes: Needs a RELAY or NPN/PNP output stage rated for the DI loop (bare 3.3V-logic HC-SR501 output cannot drive the 5-36V isolated input directly). Laser break-beam receiver pairs (5V, NPN out) also land here — held-ms readout is the gap timing

Description: 12V chime / buzzer / strobe candidates (≤450mA) — DO0/DO1 stations
Notes: Load rides the external supply through the isolated open-drain DO (flyback diode across inductive loads). Playground bounds every drive: 1.5s pulse / 30s latch auto-off

Description: 12V/1A DC bench supply for the DI/DO field loop
Notes: Separate from the board's own USB-C/VIN supply — that separation is the isolation being exercised. UL/ETL listed
